tag-verification.json records the GitHub API's verified=true / reason=valid
assertion for this tag and commit. It is not a local GPG verification.
Download used verified HTTPS; no TLS verification bypass was used.

License for this configuration: LGPL-2.1-or-later.
Full upstream archive, COPYING.LGPLv2.1, LICENSE.md, source-patches.json,
lock.json and the build recipe accompany distributed libraries.
Two first-party LGPL-2.1-or-later source patches initialize/validate MOV
channel-layout parsing results and reject AC3 in the AAC-only parser build.
Patch file hashes and exact replacements are checked by prepare.py.

Shared libraries: avutil-60.dll, swresample-6.dll, avcodec-62.dll,
avformat-62.dll. Registered decoders: AAC, ALAC, Vorbis, Opus,
DSD LSBF/MSBF (interleaved and planar); DST is not registered.
Registered demuxers: AAC, MOV, OGG, DSF, IFF (DFF). Network, CLI programs, encoders,
muxers, hardware accelerators and external codecs are disabled.
The host uses its own read-only Windows handle and custom AVIO callbacks.
First-party DSD PCM profile: FFmpeg's DSD FIR followed by SWR lowpass/SRC
to 176400 Hz, filter_size=128, Kaiser beta=9, cutoff=0.5, gain=0 dB.
Container bounds/source bit samples are inspected before conversion;
Native DSD/DoP is not implemented, and filter delay/quality remain unverified.

Build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File native/ffmpeg/build.ps1
Prerequisites: Windows x64, Python 3.14, VS C++ Build Tools + Windows SDK,
Git for Windows (Bash), and a full 7-Zip extractor for the first tool setup.
Set AURAL_SEVEN_ZIP to its 7z.exe when it is not on PATH.
Pinned LLVM 20.1.8 is extracted without running its installer; GNU Make
4.4.1 is built with the existing VS tools. These are development tools,
excluded from the application and source archive's build directories.
Their pinned sources/hashes are recorded in lock.json and prepare.py.

build-manifest.json records this build's DLL hashes, recipe and registry.
Certification is unverified; compilation is not playback, seek, gapless,
device or format capability certification. Runtime validation is pending MVP.
